title: Size-eight broad-workload confirmation
description: Ten-replicate confirmation at the workload scale that blocked iterations 017 and 018, after the cross-task-supported contextual modulo alias in Parley 0.3.153.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-task success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check task success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict workload parity.

secondary_analysis: Report every session total and per-task ratio, never an amortized value without its denominator.
Report medians, ranges, repair-free sensitivity, first-check task and bundle rates, repairs, prompt size, protocol compliance, and hidden correctness.
Audit every first-check failure across all ten Parley bundles and report whether the iteration-018 rotation signature disappears.
Compare with iteration 018 descriptively; fresh-session stochasticity prevents deterministic attribution of absolute token movement.
feature_boundary: The only compiler difference from iteration 018 is the evidence-backed contextual modulo spelling in 0.3.153. Position behavior and all other compiler semantics are unchanged.
change_rule: Do not add syntax or compiler behavior from one task, transcript, or residual token gap. Any future proposal again requires recurrence across unrelated tasks plus independent general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character Parley skill is injected once per session and remains byte-for-byte unchanged. No further instruction-compression experiment is permitted.
